full: Qalam is a free learning app. It gives lessons, worksheets to print and answers to questions about school lessons. It shows no advertising.

Qalam never asks for a name, a photo, a phone number or where you live. A learner is a picture and a number, like "Book 27". Questions are kept for 60 days so the teacher can answer them; which lessons were done is kept for 12 months as counts, without a name.

The teacher at this centre reads questions and checks answers. Everything Qalam keeps stays on this centre's computer. Questions are answered on this computer, unless the centre's admin switches on an AI service on the internet: then some questions and photos of sheet answers are sent there, with no name and nothing else about the learner, and that company may keep them for a limited time, as its own terms say.

The school bag: Qalam keeps a locked copy of her progress (lessons done, stars, questions and certificates) on this server, so it can follow her to another phone, a browser or the centre. It is locked on the phone with her 16-digit bag code, which is never sent: nobody can open it without that code, not even us. It is deleted with her, and 12 months after it was last saved. Without this agreement the bag can still go from phone to phone as a file.
You can stop at any time: Settings, then "Stop sharing". What the centre's computer keeps about this learner is then deleted. Lessons on the phone still work.
